_comment: Multi-turn scripts. eval_grounding asks every question cold, which is not how anyone talks to a hologram - and it is why a vague follow-up hallucinating went unnoticed until someone sat down and had a conversation with it. Each script runs in one session, so turn 3 can depend on turns 1 and 2. expect is the outcome the service should reach: answered | out_of_scope | not_found.
